title: Fix Diagram Windows Nodes Cursor to Show Selectable Anywhere Inside
description: Sketchpad diagram windows nodes (both Kit diagram KitArtifactNode and Design diagram PieceNode/DesignNode) should change the cursor to cursor-selectable when hovering anywhere inside the node bounding box. Currently, the applyDiagramNodeSelectableCursor function uses inline body/html style which is ineffective against the global `* { cursor: var(--cursor-default) }` CSS rule. The fix is to use `document.body.classList.add("cursor-selectable")` (same as the 3D scene) which triggers the `body.cursor-selectable * { cursor: var(--cursor-selectable) !important }` CSS rule covering all descendants. Also, KitArtifactNode has no cursor handling at all - need to add applyDiagramNodeSelectableCursor/clearDiagramNodeForcedCursor calls in KitDiagramInner's handleNodeMouseEnter/handleNodeMouseLeave.
